title: What each robot sees, and with what
sub: From each maker's product and support pages, read November 23, 2026
footer: Sources: Roborock, TP-Link, iRobot (support article 31161 and fact sheets), Ecovacs, eufy pages; RTINGS and Roborock newsroom for the camera models. Structured-light sensors read an infrared pattern; they are not RGB cameras.

name: howto
title: Before you buy: settings and privacy
sub: Six things to do in the first week with a camera-free robot
footer: From the makers' help pages (Roborock, iRobot, Tapo, eufy, Ecovacs), DEF CON 2024 research reported by TechCrunch, and owner threads, read November 23, 2026.

items.head: Clear the floor
items.body: LiDAR maps walls and furniture, not cords and socks; testers say to pick them up first.

items.head: Draw no-go zones
items.body: Around desk cables and pet bowls. eufy warns zones can drop when the map changes.

items.head: Skip data programs
items.body: eufy's User Experience Program, Ecovacs' product improvement program: leave them off.

items.head: Lock the account
items.body: A long, unique app password; KISA found weak app logins on some brands in 2025.

items.head: Mind the pets
items.body: Do not schedule a run while a sick pet or a new puppy is home alone.

items.head: Reset before selling
items.body: Remove it from your account and factory-reset: DEF CON found data that outlived deletion.
